hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are oscillating between Merino-fuelled quadruple dreams and the familiar striker anxiety — Haaland would apparently starve in this system, so what hope Gyökeres? Add a Bayern Munich Champions League tie looming with Olise suspended, a clickbait Vietnamese 'technical disaster' headline, and the eternal City charges sideshow, and you have the full North London emotional spectrum: hope, tactical neurosis, and that nagging feeling something will go wrong.

daily.summary: The day began with anxiety over a double injury blow to Hincapié and Zubimendi (5/10), shifted to reverent mourning for club legend Ken Friar (7/10), then exploded into euphoria after a dominant 3-0 Champions League victory over Lille that sent Arsenal top of the table (9/10 and 8/10). The dramatic swing from fretting over fitness to celebrating a statement European performance defines the period.

weekly.summary: The week began in euphoria following Arteta's contract extension but deteriorated sharply into aggrieved fury, as on-pitch struggles, injury crises, and unresolved Man City charges transformed structural optimism into a sense of farce. A dramatic sentiment collapse saw the fanbase swing from championship swagger to incensed grievance, with only fleeting respites from women's team results or youth performances. The dominant arc traces a complete unraveling of the early-week project stability narrative.
